title: Chloe Kim 'giggling' at rumors she orchestrated Rams' Myles Garrett trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chloe Kim 'giggling' at rumors she orchestrated Rams' Myles Garrett trade
sources.description: Myles Garrett may have been traded to Los Angeles, the home of his girlfriend Chloe Kim, but she insists she had nothing to do with the deal.
